notes: News article: Arlington City Council voted to continue citywide Via on-demand rideshare service through Dec. 2024 with four two-year renewal options (term_years_incl_options = 2 base + 4x2 option years = 10, per brief's summation convention, not a derived dollar total). Signing entity: River North Transit, LLC (New York), a Via subsidiary. Quote: 'The new contract with River North Transit, LLC., of New York will continue the Via service through December 2024, with four two-year renewals options.' Quote: 'The $30.2 million, two-year contract includes $22 million for the citywide rideshare service, as well as $180,000 for a student transportation program funded by the North Central Texas Council of Governments, $4 million for Arlington RAPID autonomous vehicle service, and up to $4 million for potentially serving destinations in neighboring cities.' Quote: 'Federal Transit Administration funding, which will cover approximately 40% of the cost, and City funding, which will cover approximately 60% of the cost. Nearly $5 million funding for the service is expected to come from fares... and advertising revenue.' Does not state who supplies drivers/vehicles -> scope_type Unknown. Published Nov 30, 2022; council vote 'Tuesday' = Nov 29, 2022.
